these techniques are no longer adequate. In particular, it is virtually impossible to achieve 100% address
utilization efficiency, so the address space was consumed well before the 4 billionth host was connected to
the Internet. Even if we were able to use all 4 billion addresses, it is now clear that IP addresses need to be
assigned to more than traditional computers, including smart phones, televisions, household appliances, and
drones. With the clarity of 20/20 hindsight, a 32-bit address space is quite small.
